steps.content: You quickly set down the supplies and then take off the armor and put it back in its original place.
You're getting better and better at these tasks. However, as the weather gets hotter, even with the cooling system that Vanilla installed for you, you're still sweating heavily.
After all this, you start looking for Vanilla in the camp. As expected, she's standing on the scaffold next to the mech, welding in the scorching heat.
Putting down her welding mask, Vanilla turns to look at you, and nods.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Welcome back.
You walk under the mech. Metal parts are all piled up here; long wires hang down from the scaffold, extending all the way to the generator in the distance.
You look up at Vanilla, her usual calm face is now covered in tiny beads of sweat and smeared oil stains, strangely amusing and adorable.
You glance at Vanilla's injured leg. Although the cast has been removed and she said she's fine, you're still a little worried about her doing such dangerous and high-intensity work.

options: Shall we take a short break?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Mmm, okay.
She casually sets down the mask and welder to the side, then sits on the narrow scaffold.
Unlike usual, she has her trouser legs rolled up, her slender calves hanging in the air, shining in a healthy color under the sun.
Now you can finally confirm that her leg injury has all healed up.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Why do you keep standing here?
Vanilla sounds puzzled, but with the light behind her, you can't see her face clearly.
This is not exactly an excuse. Since arriving at the camp, you've observed this giant mech countless times, wondering why it turned out like that in the outside world.
Or rather, what exactly happened to Vanilla over the past century? Why did her life's work turn into a source of pollution that distorts space-time?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Look at the mech...? Can you see it clearly from that angle?
With the light behind it, the mech is covered in shadow, and you can't see anything clearly.
But of course you can't tell her what you were thinking about, so you just scratch your head and laugh sheepishly instead.
Vanilla, however, was misled by your reaction, thinking that you really just wanted to see the big mechs but couldn't climb up to admire it up close.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Come, get closer.
Without giving it much thought, you walk over.
Vanilla leaps down from the scaffold, casually equips the mechanical arms nearby, and approaches you.
Before you can react, the mechanical arms have held you by your armpit, and there's a great force pushing you up. Your feet leave the ground, and you are lifted up by her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Aah!
The sudden weightlessness catches you off guard, you close your eyes in fear, squirming a little.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Don't worry, I won't let you fall.
The mechanical arms move steadily, holding you mid-air without any shaking. After your rapid heartbeat gradually subsides, you slowly open your eyes.
Truth be told, you can't see a lot from this angle either, but you do discover something new.
Compared to when you first arrived at this camp, this huge yet intricate mech has undergone some shocking changes.
Under the light shining from somewhere, everything is illuminated.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: How does it look from this angle?
Vanilla holds you up high, so you can clearly see your "work" from a higher angle.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: What did you say?
You spoke too softly, Vanilla couldn't hear you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I was saying, you built such a big mech all by yourself... It's amazing. You're incredible!

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Not by myself.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I couldn't have done it without you.
A smile blooms on Vanilla's face.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Yes, we're both incredible.
